Assignment metadata:
- objective: ## Task: Create apps/extensions package for a Turborepo monorepo

The root workspace is /home/kouhei/Code/production/Browser-Extensions/web-noise-cleaner

Create the apps/extensions directory with all necessary files for the WXT browser extension. This is a Chrome extension that removes noise from websites.

### Files to create:

**1. apps/extensions/package.json**
Use @web-noise-cleaner/extensions as the name. Copy all the dependencies from the old root package.json (which I'll provide). The package is private and uses "type": "module".

```json
{
  "name": "@web-noise-cleaner/extensions",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "wxt",
    "dev:firefox": "wxt -b firefox",
    "build": "wxt build",
    "build:firefox": "wxt build -b firefox",
    "zip": "wxt zip",
    "zip:firefox": "wxt zip -b firefox",
    "compile": "tsc --noEmit",
    "postinstall": "wxt prepare",
    "lint": "echo 'no lint config yet'",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@base-ui/react": "^1.6.0",
    "@tailwindcss/vite": "^4.3.2",
    "@tanstack/react-query": "^5.101.2",
    "class-variance-authority": "^0.7.1",
    "clsx": "^2.1.1",
    "lucide-react": "^1.24.0",
    "next-themes": "^4.1.1",
    "react": "^19.2.4",
    "react-dom": "^19.2.4",
    "shadcn": "^4.13.0",
    "sonner": "^2.0.7",
    "tailwind-merge": "^3.6.0",
    "tw-animate-css": "^1.4.0",
    "zod": "^4.4.3",
    "zustand": "^5.0.14"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "^10.0.1",
    "@tanstack/eslint-plugin-query": "^5.101.2",
    "@types/chrome": "^0.2.2",
    "@types/react": "^19.2.14",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.2.3",
    "@wxt-dev/module-react": "^1.1.5",
    "autoprefixer": "^10.5.3",
    "eslint": "^10.7.0",
    "eslint-config-prettier": "^10.1.8",
    "eslint-plugin-react-hooks": "^7.1.1",
    "eslint-plugin-react-refresh": "^0.5.3",
    "eslint-plugin-unused-imports": "^4.4.1",
    "postcss": "^8.5.19",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.3.2",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.64.0",
    "wxt": "^0.20.27"
  }
}
```

Note: `next-themes` changed from ^0.4.6 to ^4.1.1 since that's the latest stable. Actually keep the original `"next-themes": "^0.4.6"`.

Actually, we don't need `next-themes` - the extension has its own theme provider. Let me remove it.

**2. apps/extensions/wxt.config.ts**
```ts
import { metadata } from "./src/lib/metadata";
import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
import { defineConfig } from "wxt";

const { appName, description } = metadata;

export default defineConfig({
  vite: () => ({
    plugins: [tailwindcss()],
  }),
  modules: ["@wxt-dev/module-react"],
  srcDir: "src",
  manifest: {
    name: appName,
    version: "0.1.0",
    description: description,
    permissions: ["storage", "declarativeNetRequest"],
    host_permissions: [
      "*://*.x.com/*",
      "*://*.twitter.com/*",
      "*://*.youtube.com/*",
      "*://*.google.com/*",
      "*://*.yahoo.co.jp/*",
    ],
    icons: {
      "16": "icon/icon.png",
      "48": "icon/icon.png",
      "128": "icon/icon.png",
    },
    action: {
      default_icon: "icon/icon.png",
    },
  },
});
```

**3. apps/extensions/tsconfig.json**
```json
{
  "extends": "./.wxt/tsconfig.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": true,
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "baseUrl": ".",
    "paths": {
      "@/*": ["src/*"]
    }
  }
}
```

**4. apps/extensions/components.json**
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json",
  "style": "base-nova",
  "rsc": false,
  "tsx": true,
  "tailwind": {
    "config": "",
    "css": "src/entrypoints/popup/App.css",
    "baseColor": "neutral",
    "cssVariables": true,
    "prefix": ""
  },
  "aliases": {
    "components": "@/components",
    "utils": "@/lib/utils",
    "ui": "@/components/ui",
    "lib": "@/lib",
    "hooks": "@/hooks"
  },
  "iconLibrary": "lucide"
}
```

**5. Copy source files**
Copy all files from root `src/` to `apps/extensions/src/`. The root src/ has these files:
- src/types.ts
- src/constants.ts
- src/lib/metadata.ts
- src/lib/utils.ts
- src/lib/filter.ts
- src/lib/storage.ts
- src/hooks/use-settings.ts
- src/components/feature-section.tsx
- src/components/keyword-manager.tsx
- src/components/theme/mode-toggle.tsx
- src/components/theme/theme-provider.tsx
- src/entrypoints/popup/App.tsx
- src/entrypoints/popup/App.css
- src/entrypoints/popup/main.tsx
- src/entrypoints/popup/index.html
- src/entrypoints/content/index.ts
- src/entrypoints/background/index.ts
- src/components/ui/*.tsx (all shadcn components)

Copy them with cp:
```bash
cp src/types.ts apps/extensions/src/types.ts
cp src/constants.ts apps/extensions/src/constants.ts
cp src/lib/metadata.ts apps/extensions/src/lib/metadata.ts
# ... etc for each file
```

Also copy the icon:
```bash
cp public/icon/icon.png apps/extensions/public/icon/icon.png
```

**6. Copy eslint.config.ts**
```bash
cp eslint.config.ts apps/extensions/eslint.config.ts
```

### After copying
After copying, verify the files exist by listing:
```bash
find apps/extensions -type f | sort
```

### IMPORTANT: 
Only create and move files. Do NOT modify the existing root src/ files - the user might need them as reference. Actually just copy them.
